newsitem.title: USA: Tosco seen restarting Wash. refinery Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Tosco seen restarting Wash. refinery Tuesday.

text.p: Tosco Corp will restart its 95,000 barrel-per-day refinery here late Tuesday, after severe storms in the Pacific Northwest knocked out its power, said a source familiar with the plant.
"We're getting back on our feet tonight and tomorrow," the source said.
The refinery, which was shut completely by Monday, had power problems starting late Saturday, he said.
Flood and storm warnings were issued for northern California and Washington state, where more than two feet (70 cm) of snow fell this weekend.
Traders said the refinery had enough inventories to cover lost output but was forced to buy small amounts of products in the spot market.
The industry source said three of the four Northwest refineries experienced power problems because of the weather.
